"""Build the knowledge graph from the processed tables and the trained models' outputs.

    python -m bmw_feedback graph        (also part of `all`)

Every node has an id `<prefix>:<key>` (keys are the source names, joined with '|'),
a `type`, a `label`, its attributes and `prov` - where the value comes from
(processed table, PDF page, Excel file, model artifact, or a derivation).
Edges carry a `rel`. The builder never creates a node implicitly: an edge to a
missing endpoint is an error, and the finished graph is checked against the
row counts of the tables it was built from (see `validate`).

Groups of node types:
    product      Series, Variant
    price        OptionItem, Package, FitmentSummary
    spec         TechSpec
    market/sales Market, SalesVolume
    feedback     Domain, Feature, Reason, ReasonFamily, Comment
    survey       SurveyAttribute, SurveyScore
    model_output VerdictCell, ModelArtifact, EBMTerm
    caveat       Caveat  (limits of the data, computed from the data itself)
"""

import json
import math
import time

import networkx as nx
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from .. import config, scoring, taxonomy

GRAPH_FILE = config.PROCESSED_DIR / "knowledge_graph.json"
SCHEMA_FILE = config.PROCESSED_DIR / "graph_schema.json"

TYPES = {
    "series": "Series", "variant": "Variant", "market": "Market", "sales": "SalesVolume", "domain": "Domain",
    "feature": "Feature", "reason": "Reason", "family": "ReasonFamily", "comment": "Comment",
    "survey": "SurveyAttribute", "surveyscore": "SurveyScore", "option": "OptionItem", "package": "Package",
    "spec": "TechSpec", "fitment": "FitmentSummary", "verdict": "VerdictCell", "model": "ModelArtifact",
    "ebmterm": "EBMTerm", "caveat": "Caveat",
}
GROUPS = {
    "Series": "product", "Variant": "product", "OptionItem": "price", "Package": "price", "FitmentSummary": "price",
    "TechSpec": "spec", "Market": "market", "SalesVolume": "sales", "Domain": "feedback", "Feature": "feedback",
    "Reason": "feedback", "ReasonFamily": "feedback", "Comment": "feedback", "SurveyAttribute": "survey",
    "SurveyScore": "survey", "VerdictCell": "model_output", "ModelArtifact": "model_output",
    "EBMTerm": "model_output", "Caveat": "caveat",
}
MARKET_NAMES = {"EU": "Europe", "US": "United States", "CN": "China", "RoW": "Rest of world"}
SALES_GROUP_SERIES = {"F70": ["F70"], "G60_G68": ["G60", "G68"], "G70": ["G70"]}
SERIES = config.MODELS                                   # F70, G60, G70 (sold, with price lists)
SURVEY_ONLY_SERIES = ["G68"]                              # 5 Series long wheelbase: CN customer study only
OVERALL_ATTRIBUTE = "Overall product satisfaction"        # excluded from survey ranks, as in decision.py
VERDICT_COLS = ["verdict", "confidence", "n_comments", "n_units", "obs_negative", "exp_negative", "index_negative",
                "ci_low_negative", "ci_high_negative", "obs_positive", "exp_positive", "index_positive",
                "ci_low_positive", "ci_high_positive", "obs_request", "exp_request", "index_request",
                "ci_low_request", "ci_high_request", "requested", "n_defect", "n_difficult_to_use"]
P = config.PROCESSED_DIR
R = config.REPORTS_DIR


def nid(prefix: str, *parts) -> str:
    return f"{prefix}:" + "|".join(str(p) for p in parts)


def _clean(v):
    """JSON-safe scalar: numpy -> python, NaN / inf -> None."""
    if isinstance(v, (np.bool_,)):
        return bool(v)
    if isinstance(v, (np.integer,)):
        return int(v)
    if isinstance(v, (np.floating, float)):
        f = float(v)
        return None if math.isnan(f) or math.isinf(f) else f
    if v is pd.NA or v is pd.NaT:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
        return [_clean(x) for x in v]
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return {str(k): _clean(x) for k, x in v.items()}
    return v


def prov(kind: str, ref: str, key: str | None = None, page=None) -> dict:
    """kind: table | pdf | xlsx | model | derived | config."""
    return {"kind": kind, "ref": ref, "key": key, "page": None if page is None or pd.isna(page) else int(page)}


class GraphBuilder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.g = nx.MultiDiGraph()

    def node(self, prefix: str, parts, label: str, provenance: dict, **attrs) -> str:
        node_id = nid(prefix, *parts)
        if node_id in self.g:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate node id {node_id!r}")
        t = TYPES[prefix]
        self.g.add_node(node_id, type=t, group=GROUPS[t], label=str(label), prov=provenance,
                        **{k: _clean(v) for k, v in attrs.items()})
        return node_id

    def edge(self, u: str, v: str, rel: str, **attrs) -> None:
        for end in (u, v):
            if end not in self.g:
                raise KeyError(f"edge {rel} {u!r} -> {v!r}: endpoint {end!r} does not exist")
        self.g.add_edge(u, v, rel=rel, **{k: _clean(x) for k, x in attrs.items()})


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- inputs
def load_inputs() -> dict:
    """All tables the graph is built from (written by `build` and `train`)."""
    t = {
        "labels": pd.read_csv(P / "labels.csv"),
        "comments": pd.read_csv(P / "comments.csv", keep_default_na=False, na_values=[""]),
        "feature_scorecard": pd.read_csv(R / "feature_scorecard.csv"),
        "domain_scorecard": pd.read_csv(R / "domain_scorecard.csv"),
        "feature_by_model": pd.read_csv(P / "feature_by_model_scorecard.csv"),
        "survey_cn_eu": pd.read_csv(P / "survey_cn_eu.csv"),
        "survey_us": pd.read_csv(P / "survey_us_summary.csv"),
        "sales": pd.read_csv(P / "sales.csv"),
        "unlabeled": pd.read_csv(P / "unlabeled_predictions.csv"),
        "classifier_metrics": json.loads((R / "classifier_metrics.json").read_text()),
        "ablation": json.loads((R / "model_ablation.json").read_text()),
    }
    for name in ("variants", "option_items", "fitment", "packages", "technical", "feature_option_links",
                 "feature_specs", "feature_fitment_summary"):
        t[name] = pd.read_csv(P / f"catalog_{name}.csv")
    t["comments"]["text"] = t["comments"]["text"].fillna("")
    return t


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- build
def build_graph(t: dict | None = None) -> tuple[nx.MultiDiGraph, dict]:
    t = t or load_inputs()
    b = GraphBuilder()
    _entities(b, t)
    _feedback(b, t)
    _surveys(b, t)
    _sales(b, t)
    _catalog(b, t)
    _model_outputs(b, t)
    _caveats(b, t)
    checks = validate(b.g, t)
    meta = {"built_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "checks": checks, **schema_of(b.g)}
    return b.g, meta


def _entities(b: GraphBuilder, t: dict) -> None:
    for s in SERIES:
        b.node("series", [s], config.MODEL_NAMES[s], prov("config", "bmw_feedback/config.py", "MODEL_NAMES"),
               code=s, sold=True, has_price_list=True)
    for s in SURVEY_ONLY_SERIES:
        b.node("series", [s], config.MODEL_NAMES[s], prov("config", "bmw_feedback/config.py", "MODEL_NAMES"),
               code=s, sold=False, has_price_list=False, survey_only=True)
    b.edge(nid("series", "G68"), nid("series", "G60"), "LONG_WHEELBASE_OF")
    for m, name in MARKET_NAMES.items():
        b.node("market", [m], name, prov("config", "bmw_feedback/decision.py", "MARKETS"), code=m)
    for d in taxonomy.DOMAINS:
        b.node("domain", [d], d, prov("config", "bmw_feedback/taxonomy.py", "DOMAIN_FEATURES"),
               short=taxonomy.DOMAIN_SHORT.get(d))


def _feedback(b: GraphBuilder, t: dict) -> None:
    fs = t["feature_scorecard"]
    for r in fs.itertuples():
        b.node("feature", [r.feature], r.feature, prov("table", "reports/feature_scorecard.csv", r.feature),
               domain=r.domain, umbrella=bool(r.is_umbrella))
        b.edge(nid("feature", r.feature), nid("domain", r.domain), "IN_DOMAIN")

    lab = t["labels"]
    flab = lab[lab["is_feature_label"]]
    for fam in sorted(flab["reason_family"].dropna().unique()):
        b.node("family", [fam], fam, prov("config", "bmw_feedback/taxonomy.py", "REASON_FAMILIES"))
    fam_of = flab.dropna(subset=["reason"]).drop_duplicates("reason").set_index("reason")["reason_family"]
    for reason, fam in fam_of.items():
        b.node("reason", [reason], reason, prov("table", "data/processed/labels.csv", "reason"),
               family=fam, polarity=taxonomy.reason_polarity(reason))
        if isinstance(fam, str):
            b.edge(nid("reason", reason), nid("family", fam), "IN_FAMILY")

    com = t["comments"]
    for r in com.itertuples():
        b.node("comment", [r.comment_id], r.comment_id,
               prov("xlsx", f"{r.model}_feedback_hackathon.xlsx", r.comment_id),
               source=r.source, country=r.country, market=r.market, model=r.model, engine=r.engine,
               label_status=r.label_status, text=r.text, n_words=r.n_words)
        if isinstance(r.model, str) and r.model in SERIES:
            b.edge(nid("comment", r.comment_id), nid("series", r.model), "ABOUT")
        if isinstance(r.market, str) and r.market in MARKET_NAMES:
            b.edge(nid("comment", r.comment_id), nid("market", r.market), "FROM_MARKET")

    for r in flab.itertuples():
        b.edge(nid("comment", r.comment_id), nid("feature", r.feature), "MENTIONS", sentiment=r.sentiment,
               feedback_type=r.feedback_type, reason=r.reason, reason_family=r.reason_family)

    units = flab.dropna(subset=["reason"]).drop_duplicates(["comment_id", "feature", "sentiment", "reason"])
    agg = units.groupby(["feature", "reason", "sentiment"])["comment_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="n_comments")
    for r in agg.itertuples():
        b.edge(nid("feature", r.feature), nid("reason", r.reason), "HAS_REASON", sentiment=r.sentiment,
               n_comments=r.n_comments)

    for r in t["unlabeled"].itertuples():
        b.edge(nid("comment", r.comment_id), nid("feature", r.pred_top_feature), "PREDICTED_AS",
               p=r.pred_top_feature_p, model=nid("model", "feature_classifier"))


def _surveys(b: GraphBuilder, t: dict) -> None:
    cn_eu, us = t["survey_cn_eu"], t["survey_us"]
    for a in sorted(cn_eu["attribute"].unique()):
        b.node("survey", ["CN_EU", a], a, prov("xlsx", "F70_G60_G68_G70_customer_studies.xlsx", "CN_EU_2025"),
               study="CN_EU_2025", scale="mean 0-10")
    for a in sorted(us["attribute"].unique()):
        b.node("survey", ["US", a], a, prov("xlsx", "F70_G60_G68_G70_customer_studies.xlsx", "US_2025"),
               study="US_2025", scale="top-2 box share")
    ranked = cn_eu[cn_eu["attribute"] != OVERALL_ATTRIBUTE]
    for (market, model), g in cn_eu.groupby(["market", "model"]):
        rg = ranked[(ranked["market"] == market) & (ranked["model"] == model)]
        ranks = rg.set_index("attribute")["mean"].rank(ascending=False, method="min")
        avg = float(rg["mean"].mean())
        for r in g.itertuples():
            sid = b.node("surveyscore", [market, model, r.attribute], f"{r.attribute} ({market} {model})",
                         prov("table", "data/processed/survey_cn_eu.csv", f"{market}|{model}|{r.attribute}"),
                         study="CN_EU_2025", market=market, model=model, attribute=r.attribute, mean=r.mean,
                         rank=None if r.attribute == OVERALL_ATTRIBUTE else int(ranks[r.attribute]),
                         of=int(len(rg)), series_mean=avg)
            b.edge(sid, nid("survey", "CN_EU", r.attribute), "SCORES_ATTRIBUTE")
            b.edge(sid, nid("series", model), "FOR_SERIES")
            b.edge(sid, nid("market", market), "IN_MARKET")
    for model, g in us.groupby("model"):
        ranks = g.set_index("attribute")["top2_box"].rank(ascending=False, method="min")
        avg = float(g["top2_box"].mean())
        for r in g.itertuples():
            sid = b.node("surveyscore", ["US", model, r.attribute], f"{r.attribute} (US {model})",
                         prov("table", "data/processed/survey_us_summary.csv", f"US|{model}|{r.attribute}"),
                         study="US_2025", market="US", model=model, attribute=r.attribute, top2_box=r.top2_box,
                         bottom3_box=r.bottom3_box, mean_score=r.mean_score, rank=int(ranks[r.attribute]),
                         of=int(len(g)), series_top2_mean=avg)
            b.edge(sid, nid("survey", "US", r.attribute), "SCORES_ATTRIBUTE")
            b.edge(sid, nid("series", model), "FOR_SERIES")
            b.edge(sid, nid("market", "US"), "IN_MARKET")
    for study, mapping in (("US", taxonomy.US_SURVEY_TO_FEATURES), ("CN_EU", taxonomy.CN_EU_SURVEY_TO_FEATURES)):
        for attr, feats in mapping.items():
            for f in feats:
                b.edge(nid("survey", study, attr), nid("feature", f), "MEASURES",
                       basis="hand-curated map in taxonomy.py")


def _sales(b: GraphBuilder, t: dict) -> None:
    for r in t["sales"].itertuples():
        sid = b.node("sales", [r.model_group, r.market_code, r.year],
                     f"{r.model_group} {r.market_code} {r.year}: {int(r.volume):,} units",
                     prov("xlsx", "sales_volumes.xlsx", f"{r.model_group} / {r.market} / {r.year}"),
                     model_group=r.model_group, market=r.market_code, year=int(r.year), volume=int(r.volume),
                     forecast=int(r.year) > 2025)
        for s in SALES_GROUP_SERIES[r.model_group]:
            b.edge(nid("series", s), sid, "HAS_SALES")
        b.edge(sid, nid("market", r.market_code), "IN_MARKET")


def _catalog(b: GraphBuilder, t: dict) -> None:
    for r in t["variants"].itertuples():
        vid = b.node("variant", [r.model, r.variant], f"{r.model} {r.variant}",
                     prov("pdf", f"{r.model}_OptionList.PDF", r.variant, r.page),
                     model=r.model, variant=r.variant, powertrain=r.powertrain, engine=r.engine,
                     transmission=r.transmission, power_kw=r.power_kw, power_ps=r.power_ps,
                     base_price_eur=r.base_price_eur, base_price_net_eur=r.base_price_net_eur)
        b.edge(vid, nid("series", r.model), "VARIANT_OF")

    for r in t["option_items"].itertuples():
        oid = b.node("option", [r.item_id], r.name, prov("pdf", f"{r.model}_OptionList.PDF", r.item_id, r.page),
                     model=r.model, page=r.page, page_type=r.page_type, section=r.section, name=r.name,
                     sa_code=r.sa_code, description=r.description, contents=r.contents, conditions=r.conditions)
        b.edge(oid, nid("series", r.model), "LISTED_FOR")
    for r in t["fitment"].itertuples():
        b.edge(nid("option", r.item_id), nid("variant", r.model, r.variant), "FITTED_ON", status=r.status,
               price_eur=r.price_eur, price_net_eur=r.price_net_eur, price_text=r.price_text,
               price_condition=r.price_condition, page=r.page)

    items = t["option_items"].dropna(subset=["sa_code"])
    sa_index = {(m, sa): i for m, sa, i in zip(items["model"], items["sa_code"], items["item_id"])}
    for (model, package), g in t["packages"].groupby(["model", "package"], sort=False):
        head = g[g["price_text"].notna()]
        head = head.iloc[0] if len(head) else g.iloc[0]
        pid = b.node("package", [model, package], package,
                     prov("pdf", f"{model}_OptionList.PDF", package, head["page"]),
                     model=model, sa_code=head["sa_code"], price_text=head["price_text"],
                     members=[n for n in g["name"].tolist() if n != package])
        b.edge(pid, nid("series", model), "FOR_SERIES")
        for r in g.itertuples():
            item = sa_index.get((model, r.sa_code)) if isinstance(r.sa_code, str) else None
            if item and r.name != package:
                b.edge(pid, nid("option", item), "INCLUDES", sa_code=r.sa_code)

    tech = t["technical"]
    spec_ids = {}
    for r in tech.itertuples():
        sid = b.node("spec", [r.model, r.variant, r.page, r.block, r.group, r.attribute],
                     f"{r.attribute}: {r.value}", prov("pdf", f"{r.model}_OptionList.PDF", r.attribute, r.page),
                     model=r.model, variant=r.variant, attribute=r.attribute, value=r.value, block=r.block,
                     group=r.group, value_min=r.value_min, value_max=r.value_max)
        b.edge(sid, nid("variant", r.model, r.variant), "SPEC_OF")
        spec_ids.setdefault((r.model, r.variant, r.attribute, r.page), []).append(sid)
    for r in t["feature_specs"].itertuples():
        for sid in spec_ids[(r.model, r.variant, r.attribute, r.page)]:
            b.edge(nid("feature", r.feature), sid, "HAS_SPEC")

    for r in t["feature_option_links"].itertuples():
        b.edge(nid("feature", r.feature), nid("option", r.item_id), "LINKED_TO", matched_keyword=r.matched_keyword,
               matched_in=r.matched_in, matched_text=r.matched_text, page=r.page)

    for r in t["feature_fitment_summary"].itertuples():
        fid = b.node("fitment", [r.feature, r.model], f"{r.feature} on {r.model}: {r.tier}",
                     prov("derived", "data/processed/catalog_feature_fitment_summary.csv", f"{r.feature}|{r.model}"),
                     feature=r.feature, model=r.model, tier=r.tier, n_variants=r.n_variants,
                     n_standard=r.n_standard, n_optional=r.n_optional, price_item=r.price_item,
                     price_sa_code=r.price_sa_code, price_via_package=r.price_via_package,
                     price_min_eur=r.price_min_eur, price_max_eur=r.price_max_eur,
                     price_pct_of_base=r.price_pct_of_base, share_standard=r.share_standard)
        b.edge(fid, nid("feature", r.feature), "FITMENT_OF")
        b.edge(fid, nid("series", r.model), "ON_SERIES")


def _verdict_attrs(row) -> dict:
    return {c: row[c] for c in VERDICT_COLS if c in row.index}


def _model_outputs(b: GraphBuilder, t: dict) -> None:
    for _, r in t["feature_scorecard"].iterrows():
        vid = b.node("verdict", ["feature", r["feature"]], f"{r['feature']}: {r['verdict']}",
                     prov("table", "reports/feature_scorecard.csv", r["feature"]),
                     scope="feature", feature=r["feature"], bad_kind=scoring.bad_kind(r), **_verdict_attrs(r))
        b.edge(vid, nid("feature", r["feature"]), "SCORES")
    for _, r in t["domain_scorecard"].iterrows():
        vid = b.node("verdict", ["domain", r["domain"]], f"{r['domain']}: {r['verdict']}",
                     prov("table", "reports/domain_scorecard.csv", r["domain"]),
                     scope="domain", domain=r["domain"], **_verdict_attrs(r))
        b.edge(vid, nid("domain", r["domain"]), "SCORES")
    for _, r in t["feature_by_model"].iterrows():
        vid = b.node("verdict", ["feature-series", r["feature"], r["model"]],
                     f"{r['feature']} on {r['model']}: {r['verdict']}",
                     prov("table", "data/processed/feature_by_model_scorecard.csv", f"{r['feature']}|{r['model']}"),
                     scope="feature-series", feature=r["feature"], model=r["model"], **_verdict_attrs(r))
        b.edge(vid, nid("feature", r["feature"]), "SCORES")
        b.edge(vid, nid("series", r["model"]), "SCORES")
    cells = scoring.score(t["labels"], group_keys=("feature", "model", "market"))
    for _, r in cells.iterrows():
        vid = b.node("verdict", ["feature-series-market", r["feature"], r["model"], r["market"]],
                     f"{r['feature']} on {r['model']} in {r['market']}: {r['verdict']}",
                     prov("derived", "scoring.score(labels, group_keys=(feature, model, market))",
                          f"{r['feature']}|{r['model']}|{r['market']}"),
                     scope="feature-series-market", feature=r["feature"], model=r["model"], market=r["market"],
                     **_verdict_attrs(r))
        b.edge(vid, nid("feature", r["feature"]), "SCORES")
        b.edge(vid, nid("series", r["model"]), "SCORES")
        b.edge(vid, nid("market", r["market"]), "SCORES")

    cm = t["classifier_metrics"]
    names = {"feedback_type": "Feedback-type classifier", "domain": "Domain classifier",
             "feature": "Feature classifier"}
    for task, m in cm["tasks"].items():
        b.node("model", [f"{task}_classifier"], names.get(task, task),
               prov("model", f"models/{task}.joblib", "reports/classifier_metrics.json"),
               method="TF-IDF + one-vs-rest logistic regression, 5-fold CV",
               n_training_comments=cm.get("n_training_comments"),
               **{k: m.get(k) for k in ("micro_f1", "macro_f1", "top1_hit", "top3_hit", "n_comments", "n_labels",
                                       "majority_baseline_micro_f1")})
    e = t["ablation"]["complaint_risk_ebm"]
    ctx_only = e["all_features"]["variants"]["context_only"]
    b.node("model", ["complaint_ebm"], "Complaint model (explainable boosting machine)",
           prov("model", "models/complaint_risk.joblib", "reports/model_ablation.json"),
           method="EBM on comment context, feature-grouped 5-fold CV", inputs=e["production_inputs"],
           auc_mean=ctx_only["auc_mean"], auc_sd=ctx_only["auc_sd"], n_units=e["all_features"]["n_units"],
           complaint_rate=e["all_features"]["complaint_rate"], pdf_auc_gain_mean=e["all_features"]["pdf_auc_gain_mean"])
    fr = t["ablation"]["feature_classifier_fitment"]
    b.node("model", ["fitment_reranker"], "Price-list fitment re-ranker",
           prov("model", "models/feature_reranker.json", "reports/model_ablation.json"),
           method="re-ranks feature-classifier candidates by the feature's fitment on the comment's car",
           fitment_gain_top1_linked=fr["fitment_gain_top1_linked"], mcnemar_fixes=fr["mcnemar_linked"]["fitment_fixes"],
           mcnemar_breaks=fr["mcnemar_linked"]["fitment_breaks"], mcnemar_p=fr["mcnemar_linked"]["p_value"])
    b.edge(nid("model", "fitment_reranker"), nid("model", "feature_classifier"), "RERANKS")

    targets = {"domain": "domain", "market": "market", "model": "series"}
    for term in e["global_production"]:

                     prov("model", "models/complaint_risk.joblib", "reports/model_ablation.json#global_production"),
                     term=term["term"], importance=term["importance"],
                     shape=[{"bin": s["bin"], "score": s["score"]} for s in term["shape"]])
        b.edge(tid, nid("model", "complaint_ebm"), "TERM_OF")
        prefix = targets.get(term["term"])
        for s in term["shape"] if prefix else []:
            target = nid(prefix, s["bin"])
            if target in b.g:
                b.edge(tid, target, "CONTRIBUTES", bin=s["bin"], score=s["score"])


def _caveats(b: GraphBuilder, t: dict) -> None:
    def cav(key, text, targets, **attrs):
        cid = b.node("caveat", [key], text, prov("derived", "bmw_feedback/graph/build.py", key), text=text, **attrs)
        for target in targets:
            b.edge(cid, target, "QUALIFIES")

    cav("prices-de-only", "Prices and equipment come from the German price lists (July 2026, EUR incl. 19% VAT). "
        "The data has no price list for any other market.", [nid("series", s) for s in SERIES])

    com = t["comments"]
    n_cn = int((com["market"] == "CN").sum())
    if n_cn == 0:
        cav("no-china-feedback", f"No customer comment in the data comes from China (0 of {len(com):,} comments).",
            [nid("market", "CN")], n_comments=0)

    cn = t["survey_cn_eu"][t["survey_cn_eu"]["market"] == "CN"]
    if "G68" in set(cn["model"]) and "G60" not in set(cn["model"]):
        cav("cn-survey-g68", "The China customer study covers the 5 Series long wheelbase (G68), not the G60.",
            [nid("series", "G68"), nid("series", "G60"), nid("market", "CN")])

    covered = t["fitment"].groupby("model")["variant"].nunique()
    listed = t["variants"].groupby("model")["variant"].nunique()
    for s in SERIES:
        a, n = int(covered.get(s, 0)), int(listed.get(s, 0))
        if a < n:
            cav(f"equipment-tables-partial|{s}", f"The {s} equipment tables cover {a} of {n} variants in the "
                "price list; fitment for the other variants is unknown.", [nid("series", s)],
                variants_covered=a, variants_listed=n)

    sources = t["labels"].groupby("model")["source"].unique()
    for s in SERIES:
        if s in sources.index and len(sources[s]) == 1:
            cav(f"single-source|{s}", f"All {s} feedback comes from one channel ({sources[s][0]}).",
                [nid("series", s)], source=sources[s][0])

    gain = t["ablation"]["complaint_risk_ebm"]["all_features"]["pdf_auc_gain_mean"]
    cav("pdf-fitment-no-auc-gain", f"Adding price-list fitment to the complaint model changed held-out AUC by "
        f"{gain:+.4f} (feature-grouped 5-fold CV), so the production complaint model uses comment context only.",
        [nid("model", "complaint_ebm")], auc_gain=gain)

    umbrellas = sorted(f for f in taxonomy.UMBRELLA_FEATURES if nid("feature", f) in b.g)
    cav("umbrella-labels", "Umbrella labels (e.g. 'Exterior design') collect general praise; specific features are "
        "compared only with other specific features.", [nid("feature", f) for f in umbrellas])

    g6068 = [nid("sales", r.model_group, r.market_code, r.year) for r in t["sales"].itertuples()
             if r.model_group == "G60_G68"]
    cav("sales-g60-includes-g68", "5 Series sales volumes include the G68 long wheelbase (sheet G60_G68).", g6068)
    future = [nid("sales", r.model_group, r.market_code, r.year) for r in t["sales"].itertuples() if r.year > 2025]
    cav("sales-forecast", "Volumes after 2025 are planning figures from sales_volumes.xlsx, not actual sales.", future)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- validation
def validate(g: nx.MultiDiGraph, t: dict) -> list:
    """Counts in the graph against the tables it was built from. Raises on any mismatch."""
    types = pd.Series([d["type"] for _, d in g.nodes(data=True)]).value_counts()
    rels = pd.Series([d["rel"] for _, _, d in g.edges(data=True)]).value_counts()
    flab = t["labels"][t["labels"]["is_feature_label"]]
    cells = scoring.score(t["labels"], group_keys=("feature", "model", "market"))
    expected = [
        ("Feature nodes = rows of feature_scorecard.csv", types.get("Feature", 0), len(t["feature_scorecard"])),
        ("Feature nodes = distinct feature labels", types.get("Feature", 0), flab["feature"].nunique()),
        ("Domain nodes = taxonomy domains", types.get("Domain", 0), len(taxonomy.DOMAINS)),
        ("Reason nodes = distinct reasons", types.get("Reason", 0), flab["reason"].nunique()),
        ("Comment nodes = rows of comments.csv", types.get("Comment", 0), len(t["comments"])),
        ("MENTIONS edges = feature-label rows", rels.get("MENTIONS", 0), len(flab)),
        ("PREDICTED_AS edges = unlabeled predictions", rels.get("PREDICTED_AS", 0), len(t["unlabeled"])),
        ("Variant nodes = rows of catalog_variants.csv", types.get("Variant", 0), len(t["variants"])),
        ("OptionItem nodes = rows of catalog_option_items.csv", types.get("OptionItem", 0), len(t["option_items"])),
        ("FITTED_ON edges = rows of catalog_fitment.csv", rels.get("FITTED_ON", 0), len(t["fitment"])),
        ("TechSpec nodes = rows of catalog_technical.csv", types.get("TechSpec", 0), len(t["technical"])),
        ("LINKED_TO edges = rows of catalog_feature_option_links.csv", rels.get("LINKED_TO", 0),
         len(t["feature_option_links"])),
        ("HAS_SPEC edges = rows of catalog_feature_specs.csv", rels.get("HAS_SPEC", 0), len(t["feature_specs"])),
        ("FitmentSummary nodes = rows of catalog_feature_fitment_summary.csv", types.get("FitmentSummary", 0),
         len(t["feature_fitment_summary"])),
        ("SalesVolume nodes = rows of sales.csv", types.get("SalesVolume", 0), len(t["sales"])),
        ("SurveyScore nodes = rows of both survey tables", types.get("SurveyScore", 0),
         len(t["survey_cn_eu"]) + len(t["survey_us"])),
        ("VerdictCell nodes = feature + domain + feature x series + feature x series x market rows",
         types.get("VerdictCell", 0),
         len(t["feature_scorecard"]) + len(t["domain_scorecard"]) + len(t["feature_by_model"]) + len(cells)),
        ("Package nodes = distinct packages", types.get("Package", 0),
         len(t["packages"].drop_duplicates(["model", "package"]))),
    ]
    checks = [{"check": name, "graph": int(a), "source": int(e), "ok": int(a) == int(e)} for name, a, e in expected]
    missing_prov = [n for n, d in g.nodes(data=True) if not d.get("prov") or not d.get("type")]
    checks.append({"check": "Every node has a type and provenance", "graph": len(missing_prov), "source": 0,
                   "ok": not missing_prov})
    failed = [c for c in checks if not c["ok"]]
    if failed:
        raise ValueError("Knowledge graph does not match its source tables: " + json.dumps(failed, indent=1))
    return checks


def schema_of(g: nx.MultiDiGraph) -> dict:
    """Meta-graph: node types with counts and groups, (source type, rel, target type) with counts."""
    types = pd.Series([d["type"] for _, d in g.nodes(data=True)]).value_counts()
    rows = [(g.nodes[u]["type"], d["rel"], g.nodes[v]["type"]) for u, v, d in g.edges(data=True)]
    rel = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["source", "rel", "target"]).value_counts().reset_index(name="count")
    return {"n_nodes": g.number_of_nodes(), "n_edges": g.number_of_edges(),
            "node_types": [{"type": k, "group": GROUPS.get(k), "count": int(v)} for k, v in types.items()],
            "edge_types": [{"source": r.source, "rel": r.rel, "target": r.target, "count": int(r.count)}
                           for r in rel.itertuples()]}


def save(g: nx.MultiDiGraph, meta: dict) -> None:
    data = nx.node_link_data(g, edges="edges")
    GRAPH_FILE.write_text(json.dumps({"meta": meta, "graph": data}, default=str))
    SCHEMA_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=1, default=str))


def build_and_save() -> dict:
    g, meta = build_graph()
    save(g, meta)
    return meta

"""Semantic index over the 224 feedback features, used to match a free-text idea.

Each feature is described by its graph neighbourhood: name, domain, aliases,
the reasons customers give, the survey attributes that measure it and the
price-list items linked to it (German names, so an English idea can still land
on 'Massagefunktion'). With an OpenAI key the documents are embedded
(cached in data/processed/graph_embeddings.npz, keyed by model and content
hash); without one a character n-gram TF-IDF is used and labelled as such.
"""

import hashlib
import threading

import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer

from .. import config
from .build import nid

EMB_FILE = config.PROCESSED_DIR / "graph_embeddings.npz"


def feature_doc(g, feature: str) -> str:
    from ..verdict import ALIASES
    node = nid("feature", feature)
    reasons, surveys, options = [], [], []
    for _, v, d in g.out_edges(node, data=True):
        if d["rel"] == "HAS_REASON":
            reasons.append((d.get("n_comments") or 0, g.nodes[v]["label"]))
        elif d["rel"] == "LINKED_TO":
            options.append(g.nodes[v]["label"])
    for u, _, d in g.in_edges(node, data=True):
        if d["rel"] == "MEASURES":
            surveys.append(g.nodes[u]["label"])
    top_reasons = [r for _, r in sorted(reasons, key=lambda x: -x[0])[:6]]
    aliases = sorted(a for a, target in ALIASES.items() if target == feature)
    parts = [feature, f"Domain: {g.nodes[node]['domain']}."]
    if aliases:
        parts.append("Also called: " + ", ".join(aliases) + ".")
    if top_reasons:
        parts.append("Customers mention: " + "; ".join(top_reasons) + ".")
    if surveys:
        parts.append("Survey attributes: " + "; ".join(sorted(set(surveys))) + ".")
    if options:
        parts.append("Price-list items: " + "; ".join(sorted(set(options))[:8]) + ".")
    return " ".join(parts)


class SemanticIndex:
    def __init__(self, g):
        self.features = sorted(d["label"] for _, d in g.nodes(data=True) if d["type"] == "Feature")
        self.docs = [feature_doc(g, f) for f in self.features]
        self.docs_hash = hashlib.sha256("\n".join(self.docs).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(3, 5), sublinear_tf=True, lowercase=True)
        self.X = self.tfidf.fit_transform(self.docs)
        self._emb: dict = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def _embeddings(self, embed, model: str) -> np.ndarray:
        """Feature-document embeddings for `model`, from the cache file or computed once."""
        with self._lock:
            if model in self._emb:
                return self._emb[model]
            if EMB_FILE.exists():
                z = np.load(EMB_FILE, allow_pickle=False)
                if str(z["model"]) == model and str(z["docs_hash"]) == self.docs_hash:
                    self._emb[model] = z["vectors"]
                    return self._emb[model]
            vecs = np.vstack([embed(self.docs[i:i + 96], model) for i in range(0, len(self.docs), 96)])
            vecs = vecs / np.linalg.norm(vecs, axis=1, keepdims=True)
            np.savez(EMB_FILE, vectors=vecs, model=np.array(model), docs_hash=np.array(self.docs_hash))
            self._emb[model] = vecs
            return vecs

    def search(self, text: str, k: int = 8, embed=None, model: str | None = None) -> dict:
        """Top-k features for `text`. embed(texts, model) -> array; None means TF-IDF."""
        if embed is not None and model:
            vecs = self._embeddings(embed, model)
            q = embed([text], model)[0]
            q = q / np.linalg.norm(q)
            sims = vecs @ q
            method = f"embeddings ({model})"
        else:
            sims = (self.X @ self.tfidf.transform([text]).T).toarray().ravel()
            method = "tf-idf (character n-grams)"
        order = np.argsort(-sims)[:k]
        return {"method": method, "results": [(self.features[i], round(float(sims[i]), 4)) for i in order]}

"""Pydantic contracts between the three agents, the decision engine and the frontend.

Models ending in `LLM` are what a language model is asked to return. They are
kept free of defaults and dict fields so OpenAI's strict structured outputs
accept them. Everything an LLM returns is then re-validated into the strict
models below with the context it must respect (e.g. the allowed feature names).
"""

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ValidationInfo, field_validator, model_validator

Series = Literal["F70", "G60", "G70"]
Market = Literal["EU", "US", "CN", "RoW"]
Move = Literal["fix_existing", "make_standard", "new_option", "price_change", "introduce_on_series", "unspecified"]
Novelty = Literal["matches_existing", "related_only", "new_to_data"]
SERIES: tuple = ("F70", "G60", "G70")
MARKETS: tuple = ("EU", "US", "CN", "RoW")
MAX_FEATURES = 3

MOVE_LABELS = {
    "fix_existing": "Fix or improve what exists",
    "make_standard": "Make it standard equipment",
    "new_option": "Offer it as a new option",
    "price_change": "Change the price",
    "introduce_on_series": "Introduce it on another series",
    "unspecified": "Not specified",
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Agent 1: retriever
class Candidate(BaseModel):
    """A feature the code (not the LLM) found for the idea, with how it was found."""
    feature: str
    node_id: str
    domain: str
    verdict: str
    n_comments: int
    umbrella: bool
    methods: dict[str, float]          # e.g. {"alias": 1.0, "classifier": 0.42, "semantic": 0.61}
    how: list[str]                     # human-readable match reasons


class FeaturePickLLM(BaseModel):
    feature: str
    reason: str


class IdeaSpecLLM(BaseModel):
    summary: str
    features: list[FeaturePickLLM]
    series: list[Series]
    markets: list[Market]
    move: Move
    proposed_price_eur: float | None
    novelty: Novelty
    ambiguities: list[str]


class FeaturePick(BaseModel):
    feature: str
    node_id: str
    reason: str
    methods: dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IdeaSpec(BaseModel):
    """What the idea is about, validated against the knowledge graph. Confirmed or edited by the PM."""
    idea: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    summary: str
    features: list[FeaturePick] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_FEATURES)
    series: list[Series] = Field(default_factory=list)       # empty = all series
    markets: list[Market] = Field(default_factory=list)      # empty = all markets
    move: Move = "unspecified"
    proposed_price_eur: float | None = None
    novelty: Novelty = "matches_existing"
    ambiguities: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    method: str = "rules"

    @field_validator("proposed_price_eur")
    @classmethod
    def _price_positive(cls, v):
        if v is not None and not (0 < v < 1_000_000):
            raise ValueError("proposed_price_eur must be a positive amount in EUR below 1,000,000")
        return v

    @field_validator("series", "markets")
    @classmethod
    def _unique(cls, v):
        if len(set(v)) != len(v):
            raise ValueError("duplicate entries")
        return v

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _graph_consistency(self, info: ValidationInfo):
        allowed = (info.context or {}).get("allowed_features")
        names = [f.feature for f in self.features]
        if len(set(names)) != len(names):
            raise ValueError("a feature is listed twice")
        if allowed is not None:
            unknown = [n for n in names if n not in allowed]
            if unknown:
                raise ValueError(f"features not among the retrieved candidates: {unknown}. "
                                 f"Choose only from: {sorted(allowed)}")
        for f in self.features:
            if f.node_id != f"feature:{f.feature}":
                raise ValueError(f"node_id {f.node_id!r} does not belong to feature {f.feature!r}")
        if self.novelty == "matches_existing" and not self.features:
            raise ValueError("novelty is 'matches_existing' but no feature was chosen")
        if self.novelty == "new_to_data" and self.features:
            raise ValueError("novelty is 'new_to_data' but features were chosen; use 'matches_existing' "
                             "or 'related_only'")
        return self


class InterpretResult(BaseModel):
    spec: IdeaSpec
    candidates: list[Candidate]
    semantic_method: str
    semantic_error: str | None = None
    method: str
    attempts: list[dict]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- facts (deterministic)
class Provenance(BaseModel):
    node_id: str | None                # knowledge-graph node (or request-time node such as rec:...)
    kind: str                          # table | pdf | xlsx | model | derived | config | engine | pm
    ref: str
    key: str | None = None
    page: int | None = None


class Fact(BaseModel):
    id: str
    group: str
    statement: str
    value: float | int | str | bool | None = None
    unit: str | None = None
    feature: str | None = None
    series: str | None = None
    market: str | None = None
    source: Provenance


class FactBundle(BaseModel):
    evaluation_id: str
    idea: str
    facts: list[Fact]

    def index(self) -> dict:
        return {f.id: f for f in self.facts}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Agent 2: explainer
SECTIONS = ["headline", "customer_evidence", "market_view", "price_and_equipment", "risks_and_caveats", "next_steps"]
SECTION_TITLES = {
    "headline": "Bottom line", "customer_evidence": "What customers say", "market_view": "Where it matters",
    "price_and_equipment": "Price and equipment today", "risks_and_caveats": "Risks and limits of the evidence",
    "next_steps": "Recommended next steps",
}


class ClaimLLM(BaseModel):
    text: str
    fact_ids: list[str]


class ExplanationLLM(BaseModel):
    headline: ClaimLLM
    customer_evidence: list[ClaimLLM]
    market_view: list[ClaimLLM]
    price_and_equipment: list[ClaimLLM]
    risks_and_caveats: list[ClaimLLM]
    next_steps: list[ClaimLLM]

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _not_empty(self):
        for c in self.claims():
            if not c.text.strip():
                raise ValueError("a claim has empty text")
        return self

    def claims(self) -> list[ClaimLLM]:
        return [self.headline] + [c for s in SECTIONS[1:] for c in getattr(self, s)]


class Check(BaseModel):
    name: str
    passed: bool
    detail: str


class Claim(BaseModel):
    id: str
    section: str
    text: str
    fact_ids: list[str]
    status: Literal["verified", "removed"] = "verified"
    attempt: int = 1
    checks: list[Check] = Field(default_factory=list)


class Explanation(BaseModel):
    evaluation_id: str
    model: str
    sections: dict[str, list[Claim]]       # section -> verified claims only
    attempts: int


class VerificationReport(BaseModel):
    evaluation_id: str
    rules: list[str]
    semantic_model: str | None
    claims: list[Claim]                    # final claims, verified and removed
    rewritten: list[Claim]                 # claims of the first draft that failed and triggered the rewrite
    n_verified: int
    n_removed: int


class JudgmentLLM(BaseModel):
    claim_id: str
    verdict: Literal["supported", "unsupported"]
    reason: str


class JudgmentsLLM(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentLLM]

"""Agent 1 - Retriever: free-text idea -> validated IdeaSpec grounded in the knowledge graph.

Candidates are found by code only:
    - feature names, aliases and fuzzy names, plus the trained feature classifier
      (DecisionEngine.resolve_idea - the same matching the decision engine uses);
    - the semantic index over the features' graph neighbourhoods.
The LLM (OPENAI_RETRIEVER_MODEL) only chooses among those candidates and reads
the scope (series, markets, move, price) out of the text. Its answer is
validated by IdeaSpec with the candidate names as context; a rejected answer is
sent back with the validation errors, up to MAX_ATTEMPTS times. Without an API
key, or if every attempt fails validation, transparent rules are used and the
result says so.
"""

import re

from pydantic import ValidationError

from .contracts import MAX_FEATURES, Candidate, FeaturePick, IdeaSpec, IdeaSpecLLM, InterpretResult
from .llm import LLMError

MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
MAX_CANDIDATES = 12

INSTRUCTIONS = """You are the retrieval agent of BMW's product-idea evaluator for product managers.
You map the PM's idea onto features that exist in BMW's customer-feedback knowledge graph and read the scope of the idea.

Rules:
- features: choose ONLY from the CANDIDATES list and copy the names exactly. Pick the features the idea is actually about (at most 3), most relevant first. If no candidate is about the same thing, return an empty list.
- novelty: 'matches_existing' if you chose features that are the idea's subject; 'related_only' if you chose features that are only adjacent to the idea; 'new_to_data' if you chose none.
- series: F70 = 1 Series, G60 = 5 Series, G70 = 7 Series. List only series the idea names; empty list if it names none.
- markets: EU = Europe (Germany, UK, France, the Nordics, ...), US = United States, CN = China, RoW = rest of world (Japan, Korea, Australia, Canada, South Africa, ...). Only markets the idea names; empty list if none.
- move: fix_existing (fix or improve something customers already have), make_standard (make it standard equipment), new_option (offer it as an option), price_change (change its price), introduce_on_series (bring it to a series that lacks it), unspecified.
- proposed_price_eur: only a price in euros that the idea states; otherwise null. Do not convert currencies.
- summary: one sentence restating the idea for a PM. Add nothing the idea does not say.
- ambiguities: short notes on what the PM should confirm (e.g. 'No series named; all three will be evaluated')."""


class Retriever:
    def __init__(self, engine, graph, index):
        self.engine, self.g, self.index = engine, graph, index

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ candidates (code only)
    def candidates(self, idea: str, llm=None) -> tuple[list[Candidate], str, str | None, dict]:
        res = self.engine.resolve_idea(idea)
        found: dict[str, dict] = {}
        for m in res["matches"]:
            key = "classifier" if m["how"] == "text classifier" else "name_or_alias"
            entry = found.setdefault(m["feature"], {"methods": {}, "how": []})
            entry["methods"][key] = max(entry["methods"].get(key, 0.0), round(float(m["score"]), 4))
            entry["how"].append(f"{m['how']} {m['score']:.2f}")
        sem_error = None
        embed, model = None, None
        if llm is not None:
            embed, model = llm.embed, llm.models["embedding"]
        try:
            sem = self.index.search(idea, k=8, embed=embed, model=model)
        except LLMError as e:
            sem_error = f"Embeddings failed ({e}); fell back to TF-IDF."
            sem = self.index.search(idea, k=8)
        for f, s in sem["results"]:
            entry = found.setdefault(f, {"methods": {}, "how": []})
            entry["methods"]["semantic"] = s
            entry["how"].append(f"semantic {s:.2f}")
        feats = self.engine.ctx.features
        out = []
        for f, e in found.items():
            if f not in feats.index:
                continue
            row = feats.loc[f]
            out.append(Candidate(feature=f, node_id=f"feature:{f}", domain=row["domain"], verdict=row["verdict"],
                                 n_comments=int(row["n_comments"]), umbrella=bool(row["is_umbrella"]),
                                 methods=e["methods"], how=e["how"]))
        out.sort(key=lambda c: (-c.methods.get("name_or_alias", 0), -c.methods.get("classifier", 0),
                                -c.methods.get("semantic", 0)))
        return out[:MAX_CANDIDATES], sem["method"], sem_error, res

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ interpret
    def interpret(self, idea: str, llm=None) -> InterpretResult:
        idea = idea.strip()
        cands, sem_method, sem_error, resolution = self.candidates(idea, llm)
        by_name = {c.feature: c for c in cands}
        attempts = []
        if llm is not None:
            prompt = _prompt(idea, cands)
            for i in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
                try:
                    draft = llm.parse("retriever", INSTRUCTIONS, prompt, IdeaSpecLLM)
                    spec = _to_spec(idea, draft, by_name, f"llm:{llm.models['retriever']}")
                    attempts.append({"attempt": i, "ok": True, "errors": []})
                    return InterpretResult(spec=spec, candidates=cands, semantic_method=sem_method,
                                           semantic_error=sem_error, method=spec.method, attempts=attempts)
                except ValidationError as e:
                    errors = [f"{'.'.join(str(x) for x in err['loc']) or 'spec'}: {err['msg']}" for err in e.errors()]
                    attempts.append({"attempt": i, "ok": False, "errors": errors})
                    prompt = (_prompt(idea, cands) + "\n\nYour previous answer was rejected by validation:\n- "
                              + "\n- ".join(errors) + "\nFix these problems and answer again.")
                except LLMError as e:
                    attempts.append({"attempt": i, "ok": False, "errors": [str(e)]})
                    break
        spec = rules_spec(idea, resolution, by_name)
        if attempts:
            spec.method = "rules (the LLM answer was not usable; see attempts)"
        return InterpretResult(spec=spec, candidates=cands, semantic_method=sem_method, semantic_error=sem_error,
                               method=spec.method, attempts=attempts)


def _prompt(idea: str, cands: list[Candidate]) -> str:
    lines = [f"IDEA: {idea}", "", "CANDIDATES (feature | domain | verdict | comments | how it was found):"]
    for c in cands:
        lines.append(f"- {c.feature} | {c.domain} | '{c.verdict}' | {c.n_comments} comments | {', '.join(c.how)}"
                     + (" | umbrella label (general praise is filed here)" if c.umbrella else ""))
    if not cands:
        lines.append("(none)")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _to_spec(idea: str, d: IdeaSpecLLM, by_name: dict, method: str) -> IdeaSpec:
    """Validate the LLM's draft against the candidates (raises pydantic.ValidationError)."""
    picks = [{"feature": p.feature, "node_id": f"feature:{p.feature}", "reason": p.reason,
              "methods": by_name[p.feature].methods if p.feature in by_name else {}} for p in d.features]
    data = {"idea": idea, "summary": d.summary, "features": picks, "series": d.series, "markets": d.markets,
            "move": d.move, "proposed_price_eur": d.proposed_price_eur, "novelty": d.novelty,
            "ambiguities": d.ambiguities, "method": method}
    return IdeaSpec.model_validate(data, context={"allowed_features": set(by_name)})


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- rules (no LLM)
SERIES_PATTERNS = {
    "F70": r"\b(f70|1\s?series|1er|1-series|one series)\b",
    "G60": r"\b(g60|5\s?series|5er|5-series|five series|i5)\b",
    "G70": r"\b(g70|7\s?series|7er|7-series|seven series|i7)\b",
}
MARKET_PATTERNS = {   # (pattern, case-sensitive?)
    "EU": (r"\b(EU|europe|european|germany|german|uk|united kingdom|britain|france|spain|sweden|norway|denmark|"
           r"finland|italy|latvia)\b", False),
    "US": (r"(\bUS\b|\bUSA\b|\bU\.S\.|\bunited states\b|\bamerica\b|\bamerican\b)", None),
    "CN": (r"\b(china|chinese|CN)\b", False),
    "RoW": (r"(\bRoW\b|\brest of (the )?world\b|\bjapan\b|\bkorea\b|\baustralia\b|\bcanada\b|\bsouth africa\b)", None),
}
MOVE_PATTERNS = [
    ("price_change", r"\b(cheaper|price|pricing|discount|cost less|lower the cost|more expensive)\b"),
    ("make_standard", r"\b(standard|as standard|standard equipment|fit as standard|make it standard)\b"),
    ("fix_existing", r"\b(fix|improve|repair|defect|bug|issue|problem|complain\w*|overheat\w*|broken|fail\w*|"
                     r"unreliable|annoying|hard to use|confusing)\b"),
    ("new_option", r"\b(option|optional|add-on|package)\b"),
    ("introduce_on_series", r"\b(introduce|bring|roll out|launch)\b"),
]
PRICE_RE = re.compile(r"(?:€|\beur\b|\beuros?\b)\s?(\d{1,3}(?:[.,]\d{3})+|\d+)|(\d{1,3}(?:[.,]\d{3})+|\d+)\s?"
                      r"(?:€|\beur\b|\beuros?\b)", re.I)


def _match(pattern, text, case_sensitive) -> bool:
    if case_sensitive is None:      # mixed: upper-case codes exact, words case-insensitive
        return any(re.search(p, text) if p.isupper() or "US" in p or "RoW" in p else re.search(p, text, re.I)
                   for p in pattern.split("|"))
    return bool(re.search(pattern, text, 0 if case_sensitive else re.I))


def rules_spec(idea: str, resolution: dict, by_name: dict) -> IdeaSpec:
    low = idea.lower()
    series = [s for s, p in SERIES_PATTERNS.items() if re.search(p, low)]
    markets = []
    for m, (p, cs) in MARKET_PATTERNS.items():
        if cs is None:
            hit = bool(re.search(p.replace(r"\bunited states\b", "XX").replace(r"\bamerica\b", "XX")
                                  .replace(r"\bamerican\b", "XX").replace(r"\brest of (the )?world\b", "XX")
                                  .replace(r"\bjapan\b", "XX").replace(r"\bkorea\b", "XX")
                                  .replace(r"\baustralia\b", "XX").replace(r"\bcanada\b", "XX")
                                  .replace(r"\bsouth africa\b", "XX"), idea)) or bool(re.search(
                                      r"\b(united states|america|american|rest of (the )?world|japan|korea|australia|"
                                      r"canada|south africa)\b", low)) and _word_market(low) == m
        else:
            hit = bool(re.search(p, idea if cs else low, 0 if cs else re.I))
        if hit:
            markets.append(m)
    move = next((mv for mv, p in MOVE_PATTERNS if re.search(p, low)), "unspecified")
    price = None
    pm = PRICE_RE.search(idea)
    if pm:
        raw = (pm.group(1) or pm.group(2)).replace(".", "").replace(",", "")
        price = float(raw) if raw.isdigit() and 0 < float(raw) < 1_000_000 else None
    chosen = [f for f in resolution.get("suggested", []) if f in by_name][:MAX_FEATURES]
    picks = [FeaturePick(feature=f, node_id=f"feature:{f}", reason="matched by name, alias or the feature classifier "
                         "with score >= 0.5", methods=by_name[f].methods) for f in chosen]
    novelty = "matches_existing" if picks else ("related_only" if resolution.get("status") == "related"
                                                else "new_to_data")
    amb = []
    if not series:
        amb.append("No series named; all three series are evaluated.")
    if not markets:
        amb.append("No market named; all four markets are evaluated.")
    if not picks:
        amb.append("No feature matched with a score of 0.5 or more; pick a related feature or treat the idea as new.")
    return IdeaSpec(idea=idea, summary=idea, features=picks, series=series, markets=markets, move=move,
                    proposed_price_eur=price, novelty=novelty, ambiguities=amb, method="rules")


def _word_market(low: str) -> str | None:
    if re.search(r"\b(united states|america|american)\b", low):
        return "US"
    if re.search(r"\b(rest of (the )?world|japan|korea|australia|canada|south africa)\b", low):
        return "RoW"
    return None

"""Fact bundle: every number and label the explainer may use, computed by code.

The decision engine (decision.py) produces the evaluation; this module turns it
into facts with stable IDs, a deterministic sentence, the raw value and a
pointer into the knowledge graph (node id + table / PDF page / model file).
Statements already contain derived numbers a PM would ask for (e.g. "33% more
complaints than expected", "EUR 360 below today's lowest price") so that the
explainer never has to compute anything.
"""

import hashlib
import json

from .. import config, scoring
from ..graph.build import nid
from .contracts import MOVE_LABELS, Fact, FactBundle, IdeaSpec, Provenance

MARKET_NAMES = {"EU": "Europe", "US": "United States", "CN": "China", "RoW": "Rest of world"}
SERIES_NAMES = {"F70": "1 Series (F70)", "G60": "5 Series (G60)", "G70": "7 Series (G70)"}
SALES_GROUP = {"F70": "F70", "G60": "G60_G68", "G70": "G70"}
RECS = ["Prioritise", "Consider", "Low priority", "Insufficient evidence", "Not sold"]
TIER_TEXT = {
    "standard_all": "standard on every variant in the equipment tables",
    "standard_some": "standard on some variants and optional on others",
    "optional": "an optional extra",
    "not_listed": "not found in this series' price list (no item matched the curated keywords)",
}


def evaluation_id(spec: IdeaSpec, policy_hash: str, data_hash: str) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps({"spec": spec.model_dump(exclude={"method", "ambiguities", "summary"}),
                          "policy": policy_hash, "data": data_hash}, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    return hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]


def _n2(v) -> str:
    return "n/a" if v is None else f"{v:.2f}"


def _int(v) -> str:
    return f"{int(round(v)):,}"


def _eur(v) -> str:
    return f"EUR {v:,.0f}"


def _pct_more(index: float) -> str:
    pct = round((index - 1) * 100)
    if pct == 0:
        return "as many complaints as expected"
    return f"{abs(pct)}% {'more' if pct > 0 else 'fewer'} complaints than expected for its channels"


class FactBuilder:
    def __init__(self, engine, graph, spec: IdeaSpec, result: dict, candidates: list, eval_id: str):
        self.engine, self.g, self.spec, self.result = engine, graph, spec, result
        self.candidates, self.eval_id = candidates, eval_id
        self.facts: list[Fact] = []
        self._ids: set = set()

    def add(self, fid, group, statement, value=None, *, node=None, kind="engine", ref="DecisionEngine.evaluate",
            key=None, page=None, unit=None, feature=None, series=None, market=None):
        if fid in self._ids:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate fact id {fid}")
        if node is not None and not node.startswith(("rec:", "idea:")) and node not in self.g:
            raise KeyError(f"fact {fid} points to a node that is not in the graph: {node}")
        self._ids.add(fid)
        self.facts.append(Fact(id=fid, group=group, statement=statement, value=value, unit=unit, feature=feature,
                               series=series, market=market,
                               source=Provenance(node_id=node, kind=kind, ref=ref, key=key, page=page)))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ top level
    def build(self) -> FactBundle:
        r, spec = self.result, self.spec
        self._scope()
        if not r["features"]:
            self._no_match()
        for i, fr in enumerate(r["features"], start=1):
            self._feature(f"f{i}", fr)
        self._models()
        self._caveats()
        self._policy()
        return FactBundle(evaluation_id=self.eval_id, idea=spec.idea, facts=self.facts)

    def _scope(self):
        s, r = self.spec, self.result
        series = ", ".join(SERIES_NAMES[m] for m in r["models"])
        markets = ", ".join(MARKET_NAMES[m] for m in r["markets"])
        price = _eur(s.proposed_price_eur) if s.proposed_price_eur else "none"
        self.add("idea.scope", "scope", f"Scope confirmed by the PM: series {series}; markets {markets}; proposed move: "
                 f"{MOVE_LABELS[s.move]}; proposed price: {price}.", s.move, node="idea:current", kind="pm",
                 ref="IdeaSpec confirmed in the app")
        if s.proposed_price_eur:
            self.add("idea.price", "scope", f"Proposed price: {_eur(s.proposed_price_eur)}.", s.proposed_price_eur,
                     unit="EUR", node="idea:current", kind="pm", ref="IdeaSpec confirmed in the app")

    def _no_match(self):
        res = self.engine.resolve_idea(self.spec.idea)
        best = res["matches"][0]["score"] if res["matches"] else 0.0
        self.add("match.none", "match", "No feature in the customer feedback matches the idea directly (best match "
                 f"score {best:.2f}; a direct match needs 0.50). The data holds no customer evidence for it.",
                 best, node="idea:current", kind="engine", ref="DecisionEngine.resolve_idea")
        for j, c in enumerate(self.candidates[:5], start=1):
            how = ", ".join(f"{k} {v:.2f}" for k, v in c.methods.items())
            self.add(f"match.near{j}", "match", f"Nearest feature in the data: '{c.feature}' ({c.domain}), rated "
                     f"'{c.verdict}' from {c.n_comments} comments (match: {how}).", c.feature,
                     node=nid("feature", c.feature), kind="table", ref="reports/feature_scorecard.csv",
                     key=c.feature, feature=c.feature)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ one feature
    def _feature(self, p: str, fr: dict):
        f = fr["feature"]
        o = fr["overall"]
        pick = next((x for x in self.spec.features if x.feature == f), None)
        vnode = nid("verdict", "feature", f)
        card_ref = "reports/feature_scorecard.csv"
        self.add(f"{p}.feature", "feature", f"Feature evaluated: '{f}' (domain {fr['domain']}).", f,
                 node=nid("feature", f), kind="table", ref=card_ref, key=f, feature=f)
        if pick and pick.methods:
            how = ", ".join(f"{k.replace('_', ' ')} {v:.2f}" for k, v in pick.methods.items())
            self.add(f"{p}.match", "match", f"'{f}' was matched to the idea by: {how}.",
                     max(pick.methods.values()), node=nid("feature", f), kind="engine",
                     ref="Retriever candidates (name/alias, feature classifier, semantic index)", feature=f)
        self.add(f"{p}.overall.verdict", "feature", f"Across all series and markets '{f}' is rated '{o['verdict']}' "
                 f"({o['confidence']} confidence, {o['n_comments']:,} comments).", o["verdict"], node=vnode,
                 kind="table", ref=card_ref, key=f, feature=f)
        self.add(f"{p}.overall.n_comments", "feature", f"{o['n_comments']:,} customer comments mention '{f}'.",
                 o["n_comments"], unit="comments", node=vnode, kind="table", ref=card_ref, key=f, feature=f)
        if o["verdict"] != "Not enough data":
            self.add(f"{p}.overall.complaint_index", "feature", f"Complaint index for '{f}': {_n2(o['complaint_index'])}"
                     f" (95% CI {_n2(o['ci_low'])}-{_n2(o['ci_high'])}), i.e. {_pct_more(o['complaint_index'])}. "
                     "1.00 means as expected.", o["complaint_index"], node=vnode, kind="table", ref=card_ref, key=f,
                     feature=f)
            self.add(f"{p}.overall.request_index", "feature", f"Request index for '{f}': {_n2(o['request_index'])} "
                     "(1.00 = as many requests as expected).", o["request_index"], node=vnode, kind="table",
                     ref=card_ref, key=f, feature=f)
            self.add(f"{p}.overall.praise_index", "feature", f"Praise index for '{f}': {_n2(o['praise_index'])} "
                     "(1.00 = as much praise as expected).", o["praise_index"], node=vnode, kind="table",
                     ref=card_ref, key=f, feature=f)
        row = self.engine.ctx.features.loc[f]
        requested = bool(row["requested"])
        self.add(f"{p}.overall.requested", "feature", f"'{f}' {'is' if requested else 'is not'} a statistically "
                 "significant unmet need (request index >= 1.5 with the 95% CI above 1).", requested, node=vnode,
                 kind="table", ref=card_ref, key=f, feature=f)
        nd, nu = int(row["n_defect"]), int(row["n_difficult_to_use"])
        if nd + nu:
            self.add(f"{p}.overall.bad_kind", "feature", f"Complaints about '{f}' are {scoring.bad_kind(row)}: {nd} "
                     f"defect and {nu} difficult-to-use mentions.", scoring.bad_kind(row), node=vnode, kind="table",
                     ref=card_ref, key=f, feature=f)
        if fr["umbrella"]:
            self.add(f"{p}.umbrella", "caveat", f"'{f}' is an umbrella label: annotators file general praise here, "
                     "so judge it at domain level.", True, node=nid("feature", f), kind="config",
                     ref="bmw_feedback/taxonomy.py UMBRELLA_FEATURES", feature=f)
        reasons = scoring.reason_breakdown(self.engine.ctx.labels, f)
        for sent, word in (("negative", "complaint"), ("positive", "praise"), ("request", "request")):
            fams = reasons[sent]["families"]
            if fams:
                text = "; ".join(f"{k} ({v} comments)" for k, v in fams.items())
                self.add(f"{p}.reasons.{sent}", "feature", f"Top {word} reasons for '{f}': {text}.",
                         next(iter(fams)), node=nid("feature", f), kind="table", ref="data/processed/labels.csv",
                         key=f"{f} / {sent}", feature=f)
        self._rollup(p, fr)
        for c in fr["cells"]:
            self._cell(p, f, c)
        self._price(p, fr)
        self._specs(p, f)
        self._move(p, fr)
        self._ebm(p, fr)

    def _rollup(self, p, fr):
        f, ru = fr["feature"], fr["rollup"]
        if ru["score"] is not None:
            self.add(f"{p}.rollup.score", "summary", f"Volume-weighted priority score for '{f}' over the cells with "
                     f"enough evidence: {_n2(ru['score'])} (0 = no case, 1 = strongest case).", ru["score"],
                     node=nid("feature", f), feature=f)
        self.add(f"{p}.rollup.volume_share", "summary", f"Cells with enough evidence for a recommendation on '{f}' "
                 f"cover {ru['evidence_volume_share'] * 100:.0f}% of the sales volume in scope.",
                 ru["evidence_volume_share"], unit="share", node=nid("feature", f), feature=f)
        for m, v in ru["by_model"].items():
            if v["score"] is not None:
                self.add(f"{p}.rollup.{m}", "summary", f"Volume-weighted priority score for '{f}' on the "
                         f"{SERIES_NAMES[m]}: {_n2(v['score'])}.", v["score"], node=nid("series", m), feature=f,
                         series=m)
        cells = fr["cells"]
        sold = [c for c in cells if c["recommendation"] != "Not sold"]
        self.add(f"{p}.counts.sold", "summary", f"'{f}' is evaluated in {len(cells)} series-market cells, "

                text = {"standard_all": f"Making it standard changes nothing on the {name}: it is already standard on "

                        }.get(tier)
            elif s.move in ("new_option", "introduce_on_series"):

                listed = ", ".join(lad.get("listed_on") or [])
                text = {"standard_all": f"It is already standard on every {name} variant in the equipment tables.",
                        "standard_some": f"It is already standard on some {name} variants.",

                                    + ".",
                        "not_listed": f"No {name} price-list item matched it" + (f"; it is listed on {listed}" if listed
                                                                                 else "") + ".",
                        }.get(tier)
            if text:
                self.add(f"{p}.move.{m}", "move", text, value, node=nid("fitment", f, m)
                         if nid("fitment", f, m) in self.g else nid("series", m), kind="derived",
                         ref=f"IdeaSpec move vs {m}_OptionList.PDF", feature=f, series=m)

    def _ebm(self, p, fr):
        f, d = fr["feature"], fr["domain"]
        term = nid("ebmterm", "domain")
        if term not in self.g:
            return
        terms = sorted((n for n in self.g.nodes if n.startswith("ebmterm:")),
                       key=lambda n: -self.g.nodes[n]["importance"])
        rank = terms.index(term) + 1

        imp = self.g.nodes[term]["importance"]
        self.add(f"{p}.ebm.domain", "model", f"Complaint model (EBM): comments in the domain '{d}' get {score:+.2f} "
                 f"log-odds of being a complaint (the domain input ranks {rank} of {len(terms)} inputs by "
                 f"importance, {imp:.2f}).", score, node=term, kind="model", ref="models/complaint_risk.joblib",
                 key="reports/model_ablation.json#global_production", feature=f)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ shared
    def _models(self):
        g = self.g
        e = g.nodes[nid("model", "complaint_ebm")]
        self.add("model.complaint_ebm", "model", f"The complaint model (EBM on comment context) separates complaints "
                 f"from other mentions with a held-out AUC of {e['auc_mean']:.2f} (feature-grouped 5-fold CV).",
                 e["auc_mean"], node=nid("model", "complaint_ebm"), kind="model", ref="reports/model_ablation.json")
        fc = g.nodes[nid("model", "feature_classifier")]
        self.add("model.feature_classifier", "model", "The feature classifier (TF-IDF + logistic regression) ranks the "
                 f"right feature first for {fc['top1_hit'] * 100:.0f}% of held-out comments and in its top 3 for "
                 f"{fc['top3_hit'] * 100:.0f}%.", fc["top1_hit"], node=nid("model", "feature_classifier"),
                 kind="model", ref="reports/classifier_metrics.json")

    def _caveats(self):
        targets = {nid("series", m) for m in self.result["models"]} | {nid("market", k) for k in self.result["markets"]}
        targets |= {nid("feature", fr["feature"]) for fr in self.result["features"]}
        targets.add(nid("model", "complaint_ebm"))
        year = self.result["policy"]["volume_year"]
        targets |= {nid("sales", SALES_GROUP[m], k, year) for m in self.result["models"] for k in self.result["markets"]}
        seen = set()
        for c in sorted(n for n in self.g.nodes if n.startswith("caveat:")):
            hits = [v for _, v, d in self.g.out_edges(c, data=True) if d["rel"] == "QUALIFIES" and v in targets]
            if hits and c not in seen:
                seen.add(c)
                slug = c.split(":", 1)[1].replace("|", ".")
                self.add(f"caveat.{slug}", "caveat", self.g.nodes[c]["text"], None, node=c, kind="derived",
                         ref="bmw_feedback/graph/build.py")

    def _policy(self):
        pol = self.result["policy"]
        w, th = pol["weights"], pol["thresholds"]
        self.add("policy", "policy", f"Decision policy {self.result['policy_hash']}: weights complaints {w['complaints']:.2f}, "
                 f"breadth {w['breadth']:.2f}, requests {w['requests']:.2f}, survey {w['survey']:.2f}; 'Prioritise' "
                 f"at score >= {th['prioritise']:.2f}, 'Consider' at >= {th['consider']:.2f}; a recommendation needs "
                 f"{th['min_coverage'] * 100:.0f}% of the weighted evidence; sales year {pol['volume_year']}.",
                 self.result["policy_hash"], node=None, kind="config", ref="decision.DEFAULT_POLICY + PM overrides")
        self.add("data.version", "policy", f"Data version {self.result['data_hash']} (content hash of every file in "
                 "BMW-Data/).", self.result["data_hash"], node=None, kind="derived", ref="decision.data_fingerprint")


def build_bundle(engine, graph, spec: IdeaSpec, result: dict, candidates: list, eval_id: str) -> FactBundle:

"""Agent 3 - Verifier: is every claim backed by the processed data and the model outputs?

Rules run first and need no LLM:
    citations   the claim cites at least one fact, and every cited ID exists in the bundle
    numbers     every number in the claim equals a value in a cited fact at the precision written
                (shares may be written as percentages; signs are checked by the semantic step)
    labels      recommendation / verdict labels in the claim appear in a cited fact
    quotes      text in double quotes (4+ words) is copied from a cited customer comment
    scope       every series and market the claim names is covered by a cited fact
Then an LLM (OPENAI_VERIFIER_MODEL) judges whether the cited facts entail each
claim that passed the rules - the part rules cannot see (direction, causality,
comparisons, words like 'most'). A claim must pass everything to be shown.
"""

import re

from .contracts import Check, Claim, FactBundle, JudgmentsLLM

RULES = ["citations", "numbers", "labels", "quotes", "scope", "semantic"]

LABELS = ["Prioritise", "Consider", "Low priority", "Insufficient evidence", "Not sold", "Bad", "Leaning bad",
          "Mixed", "Leaning good", "Good", "Not enough data"]
UNQUOTED_LABELS = ["Low priority", "Insufficient evidence", "Not sold", "Leaning bad", "Leaning good",
                   "Not enough data"]
SERIES_RX = {"F70": r"\bF70\b|\b1 Series\b|\b1er\b", "G60": r"\bG60\b|\b5 Series\b|\b5er\b",
             "G70": r"\bG70\b|\b7 Series\b|\b7er\b"}
MARKET_RX = {"EU": r"\bEurope(?:an)?\b|\bEU\b", "US": r"\bUnited States\b|\bUS\b|\bU\.S\.|\bAmerican?\b",
             "CN": r"\bChina\b|\bChinese\b|\bCN\b", "RoW": r"\bRest of (?:the )?world\b|\bRoW\b"}
# Phrases whose digits are names, not data
STRIP = [r"\b[157]\s?Series\b", r"\b(?:F70|G60|G68|G70|i5|i7|M60|M70)\b", r"95\s?%\s?(?:CI|confidence)",
         r"\btop[- ]?[23](?:[- ]box)?\b", r"\bbottom[- ]?3(?:[- ]box)?\b", r"\b\d+-fold\b", r"\bSA\s?\w+\b",
         r"\b[A-Z]\d{2}-\d{3,5}\b"]
NUM_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.,/])(?P<sign>[-−+])?(?:(?:EUR|€)\s?)?"
                    r"(?P<num>\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+(?:\.\d+)?|\d+(?:\.\d+)?)"
                    r"(?P<pct>\s?%|\s?percent\b|\s?pp\b)?(?![A-Za-z]|-[A-Za-z])")
DQUOTE_RE = re.compile(r"[\"“]([^\"“”]+)[\"”]")

JUDGE_INSTRUCTIONS = """You are the verification agent of BMW's product-idea evaluator.
For each claim, decide whether its cited facts fully support it. Judge only against the cited facts, never your own knowledge.
- 'supported': everything the claim states follows from the cited facts. Paraphrase and rounding are fine. A recommended next step is supported when the cited facts motivate it and it asserts no new data.
- 'unsupported': the claim adds or changes a number, label, direction (more/fewer, higher/lower), comparison, cause, trend, market, series or quote that the cited facts do not state, or it contradicts them.
Return exactly one judgment per claim_id with a one-sentence reason."""


def numbers_in(text: str) -> list[tuple[float, int, bool]]:
    """(value, decimals written, is_percent) for every data number in the text."""
    for pattern in STRIP:
        text = re.sub(pattern, " ", text)
    out = []
    for m in NUM_RE.finditer(text):
        raw = m.group("num").replace(",", "")
        dec = len(raw.split(".")[1]) if "." in raw else 0
        out.append((float(raw), dec, bool(m.group("pct"))))
    return out


def _allowed(facts) -> list[tuple[float, bool]]:
    vals = []
    for f in facts:
        if isinstance(f.value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(f.value, bool):
            vals.append((float(f.value), f.unit == "share"))
        vals.extend((v, pct) for v, _, pct in numbers_in(f.statement))
    return vals


def _number_ok(n: float, dec: int, pct: bool, allowed) -> bool:
    tol = 0.5 * 10 ** -dec + 1e-9
    for v, _ in allowed:
        cands = [abs(v)]
        if pct:
            cands.append(abs(v) * 100)
        if any(abs(c - abs(n)) <= tol for c in cands):
            return True
    return False


def _norm(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s.lower()).strip(" .,;:!?…'\"“”")


def rule_checks(claim: Claim, index: dict) -> list[Check]:
    checks = []
    unknown = [i for i in claim.fact_ids if i not in index]
    cited = [index[i] for i in claim.fact_ids if i in index]
    if not claim.fact_ids:
        checks.append(Check(name="citations", passed=False, detail="The claim cites no fact."))
    elif unknown:
        checks.append(Check(name="citations", passed=False, detail=f"Unknown fact IDs: {', '.join(unknown)}."))
    else:
        checks.append(Check(name="citations", passed=True, detail=f"{len(cited)} fact(s) cited."))

    allowed = _allowed(cited)
    nums = numbers_in(claim.text)
    bad = [n for n in nums if not _number_ok(n[0], n[1], n[2], allowed)]
    if bad:
        shown = ", ".join(f"{v:g}{'%' if p else ''}" for v, _, p in bad)
        checks.append(Check(name="numbers", passed=False, detail=f"Not found in the cited facts: {shown}."))
    else:
        checks.append(Check(name="numbers", passed=True,
                            detail=f"{len(nums)} number(s) match cited values." if nums else "No numbers."))

    cited_text = " ".join(f.statement for f in cited) + " " + " ".join(str(f.value) for f in cited)
    used = set()
    for label in LABELS:
        if re.search(rf"['‘\"“]{re.escape(label)}['’\"”]", claim.text, re.I):
            used.add(label)
    for label in UNQUOTED_LABELS:
        if re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(label)}\b", claim.text):
            used.add(label)
    missing = [lb for lb in sorted(used) if not re.search(rf"['‘]?{re.escape(lb)}['’]?(?![a-z])", cited_text,
                                                          re.I)]
    checks.append(Check(name="labels", passed=not missing,
                        detail=(f"Label(s) not in the cited facts: {', '.join(missing)}." if missing else
                                f"{len(used)} label(s) match." if used else "No labels.")))

    sources = [str(f.value) for f in cited if f.group == "quote"] + [f.statement for f in cited]
    norm_sources = [_norm(s) for s in sources]
    bad_quotes = []
    for q in DQUOTE_RE.findall(claim.text):
        if len(q.split()) < 4:
            continue
        parts = [_norm(p) for p in re.split(r"…|\.\.\.", q) if _norm(p)]
        if not all(any(p in s for s in norm_sources) for p in parts):
            bad_quotes.append(q[:60])
    checks.append(Check(name="quotes", passed=not bad_quotes,
                        detail=(f"Not copied from a cited comment: “{bad_quotes[0]}”." if bad_quotes else
                                "Quotes match cited comments." if DQUOTE_RE.search(claim.text) else "No quotes.")))

    scope_missing = []
    for code, rx in SERIES_RX.items():
        if re.search(rx, claim.text) and not (any(f.series == code for f in cited) or re.search(rx, cited_text)):
            scope_missing.append(code)
    for code, rx in MARKET_RX.items():
        if re.search(rx, claim.text) and not (any(f.market == code for f in cited) or re.search(rx, cited_text)):
            scope_missing.append(code)
    checks.append(Check(name="scope", passed=not scope_missing,
                        detail=(f"Names {', '.join(scope_missing)} but no cited fact covers it." if scope_missing
                                else "Series and markets match the cited facts.")))
    return checks


def verify(claims: list[Claim], bundle: FactBundle, llm=None) -> list[Claim]:
    """Run the rules, then the semantic judge on what passed. Returns claims with checks and status set."""
    index = bundle.index()
    for c in claims:
        c.checks = rule_checks(c, index)
    passing = [c for c in claims if all(ch.passed for ch in c.checks)]
    if llm is not None and passing:
        blocks = []
        for c in passing:
            facts = "\n".join(f"    {i}: {index[i].statement}" for i in c.fact_ids)
            blocks.append(f"claim_id: {c.id}\nclaim: {c.text}\ncited facts:\n{facts}")
        result = llm.parse("verifier", JUDGE_INSTRUCTIONS, "\n\n".join(blocks), JudgmentsLLM)
        by_id = {j.claim_id: j for j in result.judgments}
        for c in passing:
            j = by_id.get(c.id)
            if j is None:
                c.checks.append(Check(name="semantic", passed=False, detail="The verifier returned no judgment."))
            else:
                c.checks.append(Check(name="semantic", passed=j.verdict == "supported", detail=j.reason))
    for c in claims:
        if llm is None and all(ch.passed for ch in c.checks):
            c.checks.append(Check(name="semantic", passed=False, detail="Semantic check needs the verifier model."))
        c.status = "verified" if all(ch.passed for ch in c.checks) else "removed"
    return claims
